title.narrative: Integrated emergency shelter assistance through the provision of winterization NFIs in the Gaza Strip

description.narrative: ltpgtAs winter approaches, the urgent need for adequate shelter and non-food items (NFIs) in the Gaza Strip has reached a critical point. The ongoing conflict has exacerbated the housing crisis, with the Ministry of Public Works and Housing estimating that 141,000 homes are completely destroyed and 70,300 houses are severely damaged. This devastation has left more than 50% of families in the Gaza Strip vulnerable and exposed to severe weather conditions. This project proposal aims to deliver immediate support to address the emergency shelter needs of displaced and affected communities throughout the winter season.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThis initiative directly targets the provision of emergency winterization support to internally displaced persons (IDPs), including:lt/pgtltpgtltbrgt1. Distribution of adult winter clothing to 2,548 individuals, targeting both men and women, with 1,274 individuals from each gender.ltbrgt2. Distribution of framing kits to 3,012 families (15,060 individuals).lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThe selection criteria for adult winter clothing distribution and framing kits are crafted to address the urgent needs of vulnerable individuals and families in Gaza. Due to current challenges in the timely delivery of these items, distributions will occur separately, aligned with the timing of material receipts. This process will depend on safe and adequate access to crossings, which are essential for delivering these materials into Gaza.ltbrgtltbgtltbrgtlt/bgtlt/pgtltpgtltbgtAdult Winter Clothing Distribution: lt/bgtThe distribution of winter clothing will not be limited to every adult member of each family, nor will it specifically target adults over 18. Instead, the focus will be on vulnerable adult individuals, regardless of their family structure. The criteria for selection include:ltbrgt1. Newly Displaced Individuals: This category encompasses individuals displaced due to adverse weather conditions or security situations, such as evacuation orders or the destruction of their homes. Many of these individuals have lost everything and are classified as part of the vulnerable caseload.ltbrgt2. Specific Vulnerabilities: The distribution will prioritize individuals who are persons with disabilities, the elderly, or those with chronic medical conditions, ensuring that the most vulnerable receive essential support.ltbrgtThe intent is to focus on the needs of individuals rather than treating families as single units, thereby effectively addressing the specific challenges faced by vulnerable adults.ltbrgtltbgtltbrgtlt/bgtlt/pgtltpgtltbgtFraming Kits Distribution:lt/bgt In contrast, the distribution of framing kits will target vulnerable families. The criteria for selecting these families include:ltbrgt1. Newly Displaced Families: Similar to the individual criteria, this group includes families newly displaced due to adverse weather conditions or security situations. The emphasis will be on assisting households residing in makeshift shelters, which are at heightened risk of being adversely affected by harsh winter conditions, including rain.ltbrgt2. Vulnerable Family Criteria: To prioritize families benefiting from framing kits, criteria such as family size, female-headed households (FHH), individuals with disabilities (PwD), and elderly members will be utilized. This prioritization is crucial, especially since the number of framing kits provided under this project is designed to cover families in most need.ltbrgtBy clearly outlining these selection criteria, we ensure that distributions are conducted effectively and equitably, addressing the critical needs of those most affected by the current situation in Gaza.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtThis project will strengthen and complement UNRWA's ongoing winterization efforts, which include the procurement of tarpaulin sheets, winter clothes for children and adults, mattresses, blankets, dignity kits, and other hygiene items and cleaning supplies.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltspangtlt/spangtlt/pgt
